newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound takes stake in Mexican bus line.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound takes stake in Mexican bus line.

text.p: Greyhound Lines Inc said Tuesday it bought a 49 percent interest in privately-owned Mexican bus company Crucero for a nominal amount of cash as part of its strategy to expand its U.S.-Mexican service.

Greyhound bought its stake through its S.I.T.A. Inc subsidiary. As part of the deal, S.I.T.A. intends to sell a 49 percent interest in its Los Rapidos bus line to the owners of Crucero, Greyhound said.
Crucero operates eight daily round trips between Los Angeles and Tijuana, including one daily trip from Los Angeles to Ciudad and will expand into Arizona soon, the company said.
Seperately, Greyhound said it and Mexico's Autobuses de Oriente agreed to sell each other's tickets.
